## Data

The source is Google's
[GA4 obfuscated sample e-commerce dataset](https://developers.google.com/analytics/bigquery/web-ecommerce-demo-dataset)
in BigQuery: ${formatCount(coverage.daily_tables)} daily tables from the Google Merchandise
Store, ${formatCount(coverage.events)} events, ${formatCount(coverage.users)} users, and
${formatCount(coverage.sessions)} sessions. Google states no licence for the data itself, so the
repository publishes only SQL and aggregated counts, never event rows. Some fields hold placeholder
values, and Google warns that obfuscation limits internal consistency; the
[data profile](https://github.com/jeevallucas/p01-checkout-funnel/blob/main/docs/data-profile.md)
measures both.

## Definitions

- **Session**: a user ID plus GA4's session ID. No session spans two device categories.
- **Step conversion**: of the sessions with the previous step's event, the share that also has
  this step's event, in any order.
- **First-time buyer**: first purchase inside the export, by a user first seen on or after
  1 November 2020. Buyers with no first-touch time are left out.
- **Repeat purchase**: a purchase on a later calendar day within 30 or 60 days, counted only for
  buyers whose whole window fits before 31 January 2021.
- **Coupon at first purchase**: the `coupon` event parameter holds a code on the first purchase
  day. Item-level coupons are always empty in this sample.
- **Order**: each transaction ID once; ${formatCount(purchases.purchases_without_transaction_id)}
  purchase events without an ID count as one order each.

## Intervals

Rates carry 95% Wilson intervals, which keep their coverage for small counts and for rates near
zero or one. Differences between groups use Newcombe's hybrid score interval. Sessions from the same shopper
are treated as independent, which makes intervals slightly narrower than they should be. Test
sizes use the normal approximation on Cohen's h with a two-sided 5% level and 80% power.

## Reproduce

The SQL is in the repository's `sql/` folder. With a Google Cloud project in the BigQuery sandbox,
`uv run pipeline all` rebuilds every file this report reads; `uv run pipeline sizing` recomputes
revenue and test sizes from those files without Google access. The
[decision log](https://github.com/jeevallucas/p01-checkout-funnel/blob/main/docs/decisions.md)
records each analytical choice and the options it replaced.
